source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_operational_receipt.py tests/test_brain_attention.py tests/test_brain_sync.py tests/test_brain_context.py

claims.claim: Issue/delivery correlation binds authenticated workflow attempts to source actors, failed RUN and repair SHA, rejecting ambiguous or substituted sources.
Operational observations expose bounded workflow, job and step identities/status while distinguishing dispatch acceptance, pre-RUN failure and attributed RUN creation.
Receipt projection preserves stronger terminal/preflight outcomes over transient markers and exposes bounded causes or UNKNOWN.
Source-bound verification detail exposes ordered failed commands, sanitized test identities, error categories and availability while withholding parameters and raw diagnostics.
Completion/native projections distinguish observed structural causes and response shapes, preserving UNKNOWN for unobserved causes without inferring completion.
Brain Sync, Attention, Unified State and Work Context compose authenticated failure/operational observations and expose typed source blockers.
Diagnostic validators enforce source identity and closed portable schemas; exact admitted-Executor private reads remain separately gated.
Correlation recording remains subordinate to existing admission; diagnostic readers carry no dispatch or lifecycle authority, preserving manual/AUTO/executorless routes.

Production-consumer fixtures cover pre-RUN workflow failure, historical verification/native/completion shapes and adversarial inputs. The repair distinguishes strict detail-binding rejection from consistently rebound source forgery and asserts unchanged records and Git refs.
